-- | Generic derivation of <tt>cardano-binary</tt>
--   <a>ToCBOR</a>/<a>FromCBOR</a> instances whose wire format is the
--   constructor name (as a CBOR text string) followed by the field
--   encodings in declaration order, with no list framing. Tagging
--   constructors by name rather than by declaration index means adding or
--   reordering constructors leaves existing encodings unchanged; the data
--   type declaration itself is the wire format.
@package cborg-generic-tagged
@version 0.1.0.0


-- | Generic derivation of <a>ToCBOR</a> / <a>FromCBOR</a> instances in a
--   constructor-name-tagged format.
--   
--   The encoding of a value is the constructor name as a CBOR text string,
--   followed by the encodings of the constructor fields in declaration
--   order, concatenated without any list framing:
--   
--   <pre>
--   toCBOR (<a>ConstructorName</a> :: Text) &lt;&gt; toCBOR field1 &lt;&gt; toCBOR field2 &lt;&gt; ...
--   </pre>
--   
--   Every constructor is tagged, including the single constructor of
--   records and newtypes. Tagging by name (instead of by declaration index
--   like the <tt>serialise</tt> package) means adding or reordering
--   constructors does not change the encoding of existing data; removing
--   or renaming a constructor, or changing the order or type of its
--   fields, does and requires a migration of persisted data.
--   
--   Since the field encodings come from the data type declaration, the
--   declaration itself becomes the wire format: reordering record fields
--   is a format change that the type checker will not flag. A byte-level
--   golden test is the guard against that.
--   
--   Decoding fails with <tt>"&lt;tag&gt;" is not a proper CBOR-encoded
--   &lt;TypeName&gt;</tt> when the decoded tag matches no constructor.
module Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged

-- | Encode a value in the constructor-name-tagged CBOR format:
--   
--   <pre>
--   instance ToCBOR MyType where
--     toCBOR = genericToCBOR
--   </pre>
genericToCBOR :: (Generic a, GToCBOR (Rep a)) => a -> Encoding

-- | Decode a value from the constructor-name-tagged CBOR format produced
--   by <a>genericToCBOR</a>:
--   
--   <pre>
--   instance FromCBOR MyType where
--     fromCBOR = genericFromCBOR
--   </pre>
genericFromCBOR :: (Generic a, GFromCBOR (Rep a)) => Decoder s a
instance forall k (name :: GHC.Types.Symbol) (f :: k -> *) (fixity :: GHC.Generics.FixityI) (hasSelectors :: GHC.Types.Bool). (GHC.TypeLits.KnownSymbol name, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR f) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GConsFromCBOR (GHC.Generics.C1 ('GHC.Generics.MetaCons name fixity hasSelectors) f)
instance Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR GHC.Generics.U1
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (g :: k -> *). (Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR f, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR g) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR (f GHC.Generics.:*: g)
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (meta :: GHC.Generics.Meta). Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR f => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR (GHC.Generics.S1 meta f)
instance Cardano.Binary.FromCBOR.FromCBOR a => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsFromCBOR (GHC.Generics.K1 i a)
instance forall k (typeName :: GHC.Types.Symbol) (f :: k -> *) (moduleName :: GHC.Types.Symbol) (package :: GHC.Types.Symbol) (isNewtype :: GHC.Types.Bool). (GHC.TypeLits.KnownSymbol typeName, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GConsFromCBOR f) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFromCBOR (GHC.Generics.D1 ('GHC.Generics.MetaData typeName moduleName package isNewtype) f)
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (g :: k -> *). (Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GConsFromCBOR f, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GConsFromCBOR g) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GConsFromCBOR (f GHC.Generics.:+: g)
instance forall k (name :: GHC.Types.Symbol) (f :: k -> *) (fixity :: GHC.Generics.FixityI) (hasSelectors :: GHC.Types.Bool). (GHC.TypeLits.KnownSymbol name, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR f) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR (GHC.Generics.C1 ('GHC.Generics.MetaCons name fixity hasSelectors) f)
instance Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR GHC.Generics.U1
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (g :: k -> *). (Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR f, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR g) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR (f GHC.Generics.:*: g)
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (meta :: GHC.Generics.Meta). Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR f => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR (GHC.Generics.S1 meta f)
instance Cardano.Binary.ToCBOR.ToCBOR a => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GFieldsToCBOR (GHC.Generics.K1 i a)
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (meta :: GHC.Generics.Meta). Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR f => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR (GHC.Generics.D1 meta f)
instance forall k (f :: k -> *) (g :: k -> *). (Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR f, Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR g) => Codec.CBOR.Generic.Tagged.GToCBOR (f GHC.Generics.:+: g)
